overview_description.description:
ILLA is an asset-light FMCG-focused middle mile delivery logistics company.

The company manages the delivery process from planning to execution by digitizing each step of the delivery process by monitoring our clients’ logistics activities to optimize it and converted to sales growth. It also provides a dynamic solution that helps its clients overcome the daily market challenges of delivering products to different types of retail and non-retail outlets.

ILLA connects FMCG companies with a large network of trucks with different types and capacities to act as an internal fleet to provide full control and visibility over the driver.
